title: NOT NULL addition without CHECK constraint shortcut — unnecessary full-table scan on PG 12+
expected_feedback: Standard: SET NOT NULL scans the whole table while holding AccessExclusiveLock. On PG 12+ that scan is skipped when a valid CHECK already proves the column non-null, so the cheap path is: ADD CONSTRAINT ... CHECK (status IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID, VALIDATE CONSTRAINT (non-blocking), SET NOT NULL (no scan), then DROP the redundant CHECK. On 10M rows the direct form blocks all queries for the scan duration. Also: SET LOCAL outside a transaction block has no effect.
